news.title: FIFA Hits Argentina With Major Punishments After FIFA World Cup Final Brawl
news.lede: FIFA has handed down major disciplinary sanctions following the post-match clash between Argentina and Spain in the 2026 World Cup final, with Leandro Paredes receiving a 10-match ban and Nahuel Molina suspended for seven games. Both players were also fined $90,000 each. Argentina's assistant coach Roberto Ayala received a three-match ban, while Thiago Almada and Spain's Gavi were each suspended for one match. Paredes, Molina Punished After Final Brawl The disciplinary action follows the confrontation that broke out after Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the World Cup final on July 19.

news.title: Argentina hit with sanctions for Falklands banner, World Cup final brawl
news.lede: Argentina have been hit with major sanctions by Fifa over their display of a Falkland Islands banner, while two players face lengthy bans for their actions in the World Cup final. After beating England 2-1 in their Fifa World Cup semi-final, Argentina players paraded a banner that read “Las Malvinas son Argentinas”, which translates to the Falklands belong to Argentina. Three EPL players, including Manchester United’s Lisandro Martinez and former Tottenham Hotspurs players Cristian Romero and Giovani Lo Celso, were pictured with the banner. The rivalry between the two nations over the islands was a hot topic before the match, with the tension being traced back to the South American nation’s invasion of the Falklands in 1982.

news.title: Licence for Bonfire Night event refused after nine injured at World Cup big screen showing
news.lede: Councillors have refused a temporary licence to sell alcohol at a Bonfire Night celebration in Grimsby after nine people were injured during a World Cup big screen event last month at Morrisons Field, Laceby , run by the same applicant. The nine people injured by flares included seven children. Police-submitted evidence to the council details that two boys had to be taken to hospital after being struck by flares to the face, with one going to a specialist burns hospital for enhanced treatment. The nearby McDonald's also had to close early due to unmanageable customer numbers and becoming a target for criminal damage.

news.lede: Four Argentina players have been suspended after FIFA handed down heavy sanctions for the ugly fight that followed their World Cup final loss to Spain. news.title: Gianni Infantino 'plotted U15s World Cup hosted next to DISNEYLAND with 211 teams representing every Fifa nation'
news.lede: GIANNI INFANTINO reportedly tried to launch an Under-15s World Cup next to Disneyland featuring all 211 Fifa nations. The under-fire Fifa chief is said to have plotted a youth “festival of football” inspired by Little League in baseball. Infantino – who is already facing calls to resign after trying to sell off chunks of the World Cup – was hoping to commercialise the U15 tournament. The event would have taken place at the ESPN Wide World Of Sports Complex close to Disneyworld in Orlando, Florida, according to the Athletic.
